# Technical reference: Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II

Exact-build facts only: never apply an address to another build or body. Status: camera-confirmed > corroborated > single source; disputed entries list their conflict. Follow Detail for the explanation.

## Trouble spots

| Rule | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Stop card writes once a USB cable has been seen | single-source | [d1] |
| Only call code in a section that has already loaded | camera-confirmed | [d2] |
| Block, never spin, at or above the watchdog task's priority | single-source | [d3] |
| A code patch refreshes only the patching core's I-cache | single-source | [d4] |
| Remove a card-loaded payload before a PC firmware update | single-source | [d5] |
